pageTitle: Where Waves Meet the Reef/Fire Support Assault
name: Où récifs et vagues se rencontrent/Assaut d'appui-feu à distance
description: {{Description |title = 30px Fire Support Assault |Beidou's exhibition project is designed to demonstrate the actual combat firepower of the new Guizhong Ballista. By taking this ship to the previously scouted sites and using the monsters there as targets, the full might of the Ballista's long-range firepower can be showcased to its greatest extent... They say that surface-attack rounds can create immense explosions to demonstrate their destructive power, while aerial interception rounds have fireworks colorants added to them, making it easier to track and observe the effects of each round and ensure that everyone, even amateurs, can witness each beautiful interception... |Map Description
